articles.summary: It was two weeks after the massive 7.8 magnitude earthquake hit Nepal when we finally, cautiously, starting moving back into our homes. After spending rainy nights in tents and cars, we were ready to be back in our beds. Nepal suffered tremendous losses, and there would be years of recovery to come.
articles.title: Reflections From Nepal: The Second Quake
